name: small-real-world-validation-20261004
purpose: Small validation sample (8 tasks) demonstrating practical operation; not a statistically comprehensive benchmark.

multi-swe-bench.license: CC0 (data adapted from the listed projects)

selection_rule: Selected before any BoundedCode run, without looking at agent performance.
Slots: 3 Go, 1 JavaScript, 1 TypeScript, 1 large repository, 1 DevOps/infrastructure, 1 difficult.
Per slot, candidates are ranked by sha256('boundedcode-small-validation-2026-10-04:' + instance_id) ascending; the first candidate that passes environment screening is used.
Eligibility: the gold patch does not change dependency manifests (go.mod, go.sum, package.json, lock files): task sandboxes are offline and cannot fetch new dependencies.

Screening (environment validity only): in the offline sandbox, the dataset's acceptance tests must fail on the base commit and pass with the gold patch. A slot moves to its next-ranked candidate only when screening fails.
Difficult slot: any instance from the selected repositories whose gold patch touches >= 3 files and >= 50 changed lines.

Excluded repositories: hashicorp/terraform (all instances are from 2024, when Terraform was BUSL-1.1, not an open-source license); preactjs/preact (tests need a browser, which the sandbox image does not have).
Dataset content (issue text, test and gold patches) is generated into ~/.cache by scripts/bench-swe-tasks.py and not committed. The agent never sees gold patches.
context_continuity: prometheus__prometheus-13845 runs with a controlled interruption after 5 minutes, then resumes with a freshly built runner.

substitutions.reason: pass-to-pass test 'issues 4999' calls postman-echo.com; the sandbox is offline
4943: pinned quic-go v0.28.1 refuses to build on Go >= 1.20 (sandbox has Go 1.27); 5995/6345/6115: server-starting tests panic in Caddy's config loader under Go 1.27
go vet (printf analyzer) in Go 1.27 panics on hugo's resources/page package, so every acceptance run fails
substitutions.selected: fallback: next Go repository from the requested list that is neither excluded nor used: grpc/grpc-go (Multi-SWE-bench), first valid by rank: grpc__grpc-go-2744

screening.note: Screening uses only acceptance tests and gold patches; no BoundedCode run had happened when the set was finalized.
